pages.text: $(l:dragons/forge#dragonsteel_fire_ingot)Dragonsteel$(/l) can only be forged with a dragon's own breath.$(br2)Build a $(l:dragons/forge#dragonforge_fire_brick)Dragonforge$(/l) from $(l:dragons/forge#dragonforge_fire_brick)Dragonforge Bricks$(/l) around a $(l:dragons/forge#dragonforge_fire_brick)Core$(/l) made with a dragon heart, add an $(l:dragons/forge#dragonforge_fire_input)Aperture$(/l), and feed it an iron ingot and that dragon's blood.
Then a dragon of that element, stage 3 or older, has to breathe into it.
Made in a fire Dragonforge. Ice and lightning forges make their own kinds.
